title: Edge-on 3D button that tilts up to face the viewer
summary: A glossy extruded action button seen almost edge-on, its label skimming the top face, tilts toward the lens; the view then jumps wide and the button turns face-on and holds. One word, one object, curiosity then clarity.
use_when: Teasing a single action or feature that one button label can name
A short silent loop or social cut-down built around one verb
An opener before a UI demo that starts on the same button
Light, minimal brands where one tactile object carries the frame

look.type_style: geometric humanist sans, medium-bold, sentence case, normal tracking; one word printed on the button face, about 13 % of frame height when face-on

sfx.event: button tilts up toward the lens (row 2)
view jumps wide to the small tilted button at 2.23 s

structure.shot: extreme low-angle close-up of a glossy white pill button seen edge-on, label (one word) skimming the top face, cropped at right
structure.camera: near-static: left edge fixed at ~30 % W, button height 58 -> 64 px of a 270 px cell (+10 %, ~0.7 %/s per motion.json)
structure.motion: slow creep only, easings.linear (±0.25 s); no element enters

structure.shot: same button tilts its top face toward the lens; label letters grow taller and become legible, still cropped at right
structure.camera: orbit-3d rise: left edge stays at ~30 % W, visible height 64 -> 105 px of 270 (x1.64 over 29 fr), accelerating
structure.motion: rotateX toward camera, easings.inQuad ~29 fr (sheet ±0.25 s; strip shows it still moving at f66)

structure.shot: view jumps wide: the whole button, small and centred, top face tilted away ~55 deg; it turns face-on, label fully readable
structure.camera: pull-out in one frame at f67 (no cut in cuts.json, near-miss score 4.58), then static; width constant 146 px of a 320 px strip tile
structure.motion: rotateX ~55 -> 0 deg (from height ratio 37/68), springs.ui ~31 fr, no overshoot seen on the 30 fps strip; height 37 -> 58 px by f85, last 6 % by f98

structure.shot: button face-on, centred, one action word in black on a light grey face with a soft white bevel; flat white ground
structure.camera: near-static: width 214 -> 209 px of a 480 px cell (-2 %, ±1 %)
structure.motion: hold 63 fr; no element moves (motion.json diff 0.02-0.07)

params.content.label: one action word on the button (e.g. a verb, <= 8 letters)
params.button.color: button face colour; defaults to a light neutral, accent optional
params.timing.jump: frame of the wide jump (default 67 at 30 fps)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; button stays centred, width ~44 % of frame width face-on

notes: One shot, cuts.json lists 0 cuts; the jump at 2.23 s (f67) is a near-miss (score 4.58) and is treated as an in-shot pull-out, so every transition_out is continuous. Reference is silent: all sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Rotation angles are estimated from height ratios (front height 68 px vs 37 px at f67 in a 320 px tile), not measured directly. Easing of the tilt-up and the settle spring are suggested defaults; the 30 fps strip 1.90-2.87 s shows no overshoot. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): edge-on-reveal, object-turn-face-on. Studio has no 3D button primitive: Button3D in recipe.md Missing components. Not loopable: first frame (edge-on) differs from last (face-on).
